coded.vi: Perekrut wajib berizin dan dapat dikenai sanksi, tetapi tidak bertanggung jawab bersama atas kewajiban majikan
coded.vl: Recruiters must be licensed and can be sanctioned, but are not jointly liable for the employer's obligations
coded.n: Recruiters must register as an enterprise and obtain an operating licence from the Ministry of Labour and Social Welfare (MoLSW), and providing employment services without a licence is prohibited. Licences can be suspended or revoked. The agency answers for the interests of the workers it sends 'under the contract' and must compensate damage it causes, but no provision makes it jointly liable with the foreign employer.
coded.src: Labour Law 2013; Decree on the Dispatch of Lao Workers to Work Abroad (2020) · official text: https://www.laoofficialgazette.gov.la/index.php?r=site/display&id=2154

coded.fi: Biaya rekrutmen yang dibebankan kepada pekerja
coded.vi: Biaya dibatasi oleh hukum, atau dilarang hanya untuk jabatan atau negara tujuan tertentu
coded.vl: Fees are capped by law, or prohibited only for listed occupations or destinations
coded.n: The 2020 Decree leaves fees and service charges to a Presidential decree issued from time to time. The 2026 MoLSW Agreement caps the overseas placement fee at 3% of each month's salary under the contract. Collecting fees above set rates and taking deposits or collateral from workers are prohibited.
coded.src: Decree on the Dispatch of Lao Workers to Work Abroad (2020) · official guidance: https://www.laoofficialgazette.gov.la/index.php?r=site/display&id=2550

coded.vi: Kontrak wajib hanya untuk sebagian kategori pekerja, atau tanpa syarat minimum atau verifikasi
coded.vl: A contract is required, but only for some categories of workers, or without minimum terms or verification
coded.n: Each worker must hold a commitment contract with the sending agency and a labour contract with the employer. The labour contract and the labour-supply contract are part of the licence file that MoLSW reviews before it licenses each sending. The Decree defines the labour contract as covering working conditions, wages, welfare and other terms, but sets no detailed minimum terms.

coded.vi: Orientasi wajib tetapi dapat dibebankan kepada pekerja, atau wajib hanya untuk sebagian kategori
coded.vl: Orientation is compulsory but may be charged to the worker, or compulsory only for some categories
coded.n: Training before departure is compulsory for the worker, and the sending agency must provide it. The province certifies the list of workers only after this training. No provision found says the training is free, or that it must cover rights and complaint channels.
coded.src: Decree on the Dispatch of Lao Workers to Work Abroad (2020) · official text: https://www.laoofficialgazette.gov.la/index.php?r=site/display&id=1675

coded.vi: Cakupan terbatas pada sebagian kategori pekerja atau sebagian risiko
coded.vl: Coverage is limited to some categories of workers or to some of these risks
coded.n: Workers and sending agencies must pay into a fund to assist Lao workers abroad, and workers must join social security under Lao law and the destination country's law. Agencies must lodge a guarantee deposit with MoLSW for helping workers in emergencies. No rules were found on the fund's benefits (death, disability, repatriation, legal aid).

coded.fi: Atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
coded.vi: Atase ditempatkan berdasarkan keputusan administratif atau kebijakan, tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
coded.vl: Officers are posted by administrative decision or policy, without a statutory duty
coded.n: MoLSW may propose appointing labour representatives to Lao diplomatic or consular missions 'where deemed necessary'. This is a discretionary power in a decree, not a statutory duty. Sending agencies must also keep their own representative abroad.
coded.src: Ministry of Labour and Social Welfare · official text: https://www.laoofficialgazette.gov.la/index.php?r=site/display&id=1675

coded.vi: Pengaduan menghasilkan sanksi administratif atau pengembalian biaya, tetapi ganti rugi memerlukan pengadilan umum
coded.vl: Complaints lead to administrative sanctions or refunds of fees, but compensation needs the ordinary courts
coded.n: Workers may file complaints or petitions. MoLSW and the provincial and district labour offices must receive and resolve them, and can suspend or revoke licences. Violators may be ordered to pay civil damages, but no specialised body was found that awards compensation against recruiters or foreign employers. Labour disputes follow the Labour Law's mediation, administrative, committee and court routes.

coded.fn: Exit without sex- or age-specific restrictions
coded.fi: Keberangkatan tanpa pembatasan khusus jenis kelamin atau usia
coded.vi: Pembatasan menurut negara tujuan atau jabatan, atau usia minimum di atas 18, yang netral gender secara tertulis
coded.vl: Restrictions by destination or occupation, or minimum ages above 18, that are sex-neutral on their face
coded.n: The minimum age is 18. Sending is barred for listed jobs (for example prostitution, massage services, dangerous chemicals, sea fishing on small boats, mine clearance) and for areas or countries at war, or with no bilateral labour agreement and no diplomatic relations with Laos. All of these rules are sex-neutral on their face, and agencies may not discriminate by sex.
coded.src: Decree on the Dispatch of Lao Workers to Work Abroad (2020) · official text: https://www.laoofficialgazette.gov.la/index.php?r=site/display&id=1675

coded.vi: Reintegrasi bertumpu pada kebijakan atau program tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
coded.vl: Reintegration rests on policy or programs without a statutory duty
coded.n: MoLSW and the provincial and district offices must 'encourage and promote' returnees to work at home and to upgrade their skills. This duty is in a decree, not a statute. Sending agencies must bring workers home when their contracts end. The Anti-Trafficking Law's statutory reintegration duties cover trafficking victims only.
coded.src: Ministry of Labour and Social Welfare · official text: https://www.laoofficialgazette.gov.la/index.php?r=site/display&id=1675
